title: AC1024 TABLE ACadSharp writer profile screen
scope: Trace the pinned ACadSharp TABLE writer source to determine whether it independently emits the body-counted CadValue string shape observed in the bounded libdxfrw AC1024 fallback. This is peer implementation evidence only.
findings: writeTableEntity calls writeTableContent for R2010 and later, including AC1024.

For CadValueType.String and CadValueType.General, writeCadValue calls writeStringCadValue. In the R2007+ branch, that method writes a BL byte count, UTF-16LE bytes, and a two-byte terminator through the merged writer's main stream.

DwgMergedStreamWriter routes WriteBitLong and WriteBytes to Main, while WriteVariableText routes to TextWriter. The inspected peer implementation therefore has an inline body-string writer profile distinct from its detached variable-text path.

localScratchControl.observation: The scratch AC1024 one-cell string TABLE was reopened by the ACadSharp reader as one row, one column, with its authored text.
limitations: This generated control establishes only ACadSharp writer/reader consistency, not AutoCAD or ODA source semantics.
The generated sample is not a repository fixture and remains outside the repository.

The sample's VPORT writer comments identify Visual Style as a hard pointer and Sun as a hard owner, but the implementation emits soft-pointer codes for both. libdxfrw refuses the sample at that role mismatch.
LibreDWG 0.14 also reports invalid section accounting and R2010 TABLE/TABLESTYLE TODOs for this generated file; it is not independent TABLE semantic readback.

decision: Corroborates an ACadSharp peer writer profile and explains a candidate body-string shape; it does not supersede ODA v5.4.1, establish AutoCAD API state, or promote P5-D. Keep the existing AC1024 route raw-retaining, semantic-incomplete, and strict-output-refused.
nextAction: Do not spend another cycle on the same generated peer sample. Acquire a producer-bound AC1024 TABLE source with known API values and handle roles, or keep P5-D waiting.
